pros: Jack of all trades, master of all. Main DPS, Sub-DPS, buffing, healing, stamina restoration — Iuno does everything;
Gives shields to herself while constantly healing on most of her attacks, difficult to die from consecutive small hits;

Very flexible team-wise thanks to her ability to fill many roles, extend or shorten her rotation to whatever's necessary, and sheds some light on less-used characters who will find a purpose with her on the team;
Wait... Kuro ACTUALLY provided a proper shortened description feature this time?!
One of her Ultimate voicelines ("Answer my call") kind of sounds like an angry mother, and honestly, that's really funny.
cons: Damage-focused character, implying she really wants a properly strong weapon equipped to justify her presence on the team over already established options (most importantly Mortefi);
Gives up DMG Amplification effects to herself when swapping out, not just the incoming character — hence she is quite quickswap-unfriendly;
Prone to interruption mid-air, which can slow down her rotations a lot — watch out for enemy attacks and make sure to dodge;
That Ultimate animation will be a pro to some of you. Not to the ones who wrote this, sorry not sorry.

review.summary: Iuno is a 5-star Aero Gauntlets character who can accomplish a wide array of goals on the team. She functions as an effective mix of support and damage, as she is able to heal the team, provide shields to herself, but also deal a ton of damage by herself and even buff the incoming character's Heavy Attack damage. Iuno is a character of many facets, so let's quickly explain her kit before going into the intricacies of her position in the meta.

sections.heading: Review
paragraphs: Iuno is a 5-star Aero Gauntlets character who can accomplish a wide array of goals on the team. She functions as an effective mix of support and damage, as she is able to heal the team, provide shields to herself, but also deal a ton of damage by herself and even buff the incoming character's Heavy Attack damage. Iuno is a character of many facets, so let's quickly explain her kit before going into the intricacies of her position in the meta.

sections.heading: Key Mechanics
paragraphs: Iuno's main mechanic is called Lunar Cycle. She will primarily enter it via casting a Skill after her Intro (called Closing Refrain) or by casting her Ultimate. It has 2 phases: Half Moon and Full Moon. Half Moon is entered by default and will be ignored throughout all of her rotations, as the Full Moon form deals the majority of her damage and is tied to her Forte gauge, which she consumes to enhance her attacks in that stance. That Forte gauge is called Sentience and replenishes up to 100 points, gained from the following actions:
Intro Skill provides 40 Sentience;
Closing Refrain provides 25 Sentience;
Ultimate provides 60 Sentience.
Additionally, her Unfinished Refrain and Moonring Basic Attacks (in Half Moon stance) all restore Sentience but this will be unused in her rotations.
Her Sentience bar stores up to 100 points and will be consumed by the following actions:
Moonbow Basic Attacks (50 points for the whole 3-chain);
Moonbow Skills, called Arc Beyond The Edge (25 points per skill, 2 charges).
Every enhanced attack gives lots of extra Concerto Energy and also deal higher damage, making them a key component of her rotations.
As you can see, we already can tell a full Basic Attack string and 2 skills consuming the full Sentience bar — that's right, that's basically what Iuno's rotation is all about.

It is however worth noting that her attacks will be enhanced so long as any amount of Sentience is available — the attack gets enhanced all the same whether there's 1 or 25 Sentience available per skill, for example. It only consumes up to that maximum. We abuse this in her Main DPS rotation to take her damage to new heights.

But before we get too detailed here — how do we access the Full Moon stance? We first need to enter Lunar Cycle (as detailed prior) then cast a jump attack, called Flux. This makes Iuno enter Full Moon Stance and she's ready to begin the main part of her rotation at that point.

sections.heading: Basic Attacks
paragraphs: Iuno's standard Basic Attacks and Moonring Basic Attacks are all unused in her rotations. So they're actually pretty skippable. However, her Moonbow Basic Attacks are used plenty, particularly in her Main DPS rotations. They deal a lot of damage, generate a lot of Concerto Energy and consume a lot of Sentience. The third Moonbow Basic Attack is a particularly lengthy 2-parter and makes for a great Swap Cancel window.

Do note that Iuno's Moonbow Basic 3 deals much more damage than the first two, so it's heavily recommended to go for the full chain. On the instance that an incoming attack has to be dodged though, worry not as Iuno's Moonbow Dodge Counter packs just as much of a punch.

sections.heading: Skill & Ultimate
paragraphs: Iuno has a lot of skills, but she only really ever wants to use two.

The first of which is Closing Refrain: It is accessed after her Intro, plain and simple. It deals a lot of damage but is not necessary to her Concerto rotation — nonetheless, it's great to use as an extension to her rotation if it's necessary for her to take up more field time to align with your team's cooldowns, and it's also completely worth using as a Main DPS thanks to the Sentience generation it provides.
It can also be mandatory to use as a means to activate certain weapon effects; keep this in mind depending on your build!

The second skill is Arc Beyond The Edge: This is her Moonbow stance Skill and it has up to 2 charges, which we always use in her rotation. They can be animation-cancelled by her Ultimate, similarly to Ciaccona's Forte Heavy Attack (where we use the Ultimate right after the projectiles have been shot). It also makes for a good rotation finisher due to its Concerto Energy being instantly generated, and the animation being fully Swap Cancellable.

Lastly, Iuno's Ultimate makes her enter Lunar Cycle, and can instantly cancel any ability that is used before it. It also generates a ton of Sentience and is one of the 2 contributors to stacking up a big chunk of DMG Amplification via one of her Inherent Skills. And of course, it deals a ton of damage on hit.

sections.heading: Buffs, Sustain & How to Access Them
paragraphs: Iuno has buffs that she gives herself and buffs that she provides to the whole team. Let's detail the buffs she gives herself first:

Blessing of the Wan Light (Inherent Skill): Iuno gets 4% DMG Amplification per stack of Blessing for 10s, up to 10 times. She gains 5 stacks by using an Intro, and 5 by using her Ultimate. This effect ends if she is switched off the field.

Waxing Ascent (Inherent Skill): Whenever Iuno casts any skill at all, she grants 1 very small Shield to herself (this only serves as a means to trigger the Crown of Valor Echo set and her dedicated Signature weapon effect, the Shield itself will not protect you from any attack except a flick of a finger).
Now for the buffs she gives to the team:
Outro: Grants 50% Heavy Attack DMG to the next character switched in for 14s, expires on swap. Super strong, generically applicable buff. Also deals a small hit of damage.

Full Moon Domain: Accessed via a special Heavy Attack which can only be cast at full Concerto Energy and deals a small amount of damage, Iuno can generate this domain which can grant stacks of Blessing (the same ones she gives herself) in the same manner, being if the incoming character can apply Shields to themselves multiple times. This is only usable by Augusta and will ideally only be used if Augusta is in the team.

Healing: It is worth noting the Full Moon domain mentioned earlier, as well as the special Heavy Attack, both generate great amounts of healing, the domain granting healing as well as Stamina restoration over time. Additionally, all of Iuno's Sentience-Enhanced attacks all give a small amount of healing to the team. If healing is particularly desired by the player, casting the Full Moon Domain can be considered.

sections.heading: Meta Position & Conclusion
paragraphs: Iuno is strong. Quite strong, but don't be fooled as she is not quite as meta-defining as a Shorekeeper, a Cartethyia, or even an Augusta. The truth of the matter is, while Iuno fulfills many roles and is excellent at all of them, the characters she wants to buff work completely fine on their own with the F2P-accessible teammate Mortefi. Mortefi gives Heavy Attack DMG Bonus, can provide lots of buffs via the Moonlit Clouds or Empyrean Anthem sets and the Static Mist weapon buff being a pistol user. Additionally, his rotation is shorter than Iuno's and he still holds a good chunk of personal damage in his own right.

However, we'll repeat ourselves here — in the meta, Iuno is REALLY strong and competes with some of the best Main DPS in the game even though she's intended as a buffer, which is a really good surprise and it adds to her solo pull value a lot. With that being said, as a Support who also wants to deal damage, getting a limited weapon becomes all the more important for her to really separate herself from Mortefi, and while she is a step above him in any situation, Iuno could be a redundant pull for many. In fact, Augusta and Jiyan don't need Iuno.

But that's not saying everything — while Augusta and Jiyan don't need Iuno, Iuno doesn't need neither Jiyan nor Augusta all the same. In fact, playing alongside Ciaccona, or even Jianxin, as well as Aero Rover, she'll be able to take down bosses all on her own; even though she was intended as a buffing character. She truly is a force to be reckoned with, particularly considering she gets extra team utility in the form of healing and stamina restoration — if the player desires more of it on their team, that is.

In conclusion, Iuno is a great character who definitely separates herself from Mortefi by dealing higher personal damage, and having a higher buffing potential; but please keep in mind the characters she wants to buff can work completely fine without her on the team — their ceiling only gets raised even higher, but they retain a good floor nonetheless. On the other hand, Iuno herself is a great single-value pull by virtue of her Main DPS potential, and we completely think you should pull Iuno if you like her. She slots in a lot of teams, using different playstyles, and she's effective at all of them!

Gives a massive 36% DEF Ignore on Resonance Liberation DMG stacked instantly after an Intro and easily maintained by Iuno's ability to apply several Shields to herself, all the while unconditionally giving 20% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus and a massive CRIT Rate boost while retaining good Base ATK.

Upon casting Intro Skill, this effect reaches max stacks immediately, lasting for 3s.

best_echo_sets.commentary: Iuno and Augusta's best set. The only set that should be ran on Main DPS Iuno. Increases ATK and CRIT DMG by 6% and 4% for 4s respectively when a Shield is applied to the equipped character, stacking up to 5 times every 0.5s. This totals to 30% ATK and 20% CRIT DMG, which is the best set for Iuno and Augusta in specific as they are  the only characters in the game who are able to fully stack up this effect.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: Simple summon Echo that gives 12% Liberation and 12% Aero DMG Bonus when equipped in the main slot. No restrictions on the cast and free damage for Iuno, making it the best choice.

best_echo_sets.commentary: Only consider this set on a Sub DPS Iuno. Near-equal in team damage to Crown of Valor in the best SubDPS Iuno teams. Offers 10% unconditional Energy Regen which makes reaching Energy requirements easy. Most importantly however, upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost boosting their damage by a good amount.

main_echo_options.echo_commentary: The best and only real option Moonlit Clouds has, as it grants an extra 12% DMG Bonus on top of the 22.5% ATK boost to the next character that Moonlit Clouds would usually give. Additionally restores a lot of Energy to the caster when it deals damage. However, on Iuno, it is best to cast this Echo at the start of her rotation and cancelling it via a dash (after her Closing Refrain skill) or via her Ultimate (after Intro).

synergies.commentary: As the best teammates for Hybrid Iuno, it's no surprise the Sun & Moon duo is still a very strong team because Iuno is able to provide a whopping 90% total DMG Amplification to Augusta thanks to her taking advantage of her Full Moon Domain. yangyang-xuanling is however stronger than this pairing despite only using 50% Heavy DMG Amplification from her Outro, by virtue of her insane base damage alone. Jiyan isn't a bad choice at all though, since he can also use Iuno's Outro while being able to pair with Ciaccona to form a good Mono Aero team.

These three are the best buffers for Main DPS Iuno. Lynae is generally the best one by far as her generalist buffs are unparalleled and she provides a total of 40% DMG Amplification to Iuno via her Outro; while Ciaccona has no Outro buff dedicated to Iuno, she does provide solid personal damage, a super fast rotation and a lot of Aero DMG increases in the form of DMG Bonus and RES Shred with her Signature. Yinlin has lower DMG Amplification than Jianxin via their Outros (25% vs 38%), but Yinlin remains better thanks to having good Energy generation, solid personal damage and a rather quick rotation. Jianxin is a perfectly viable F2P-accessible choice though, particularly with higher Sequences, making all three good choices overall.

These Heavy Attack damage dealers can all be recipients of Iuno's Outro buff, however in those teams Iuno's Outro buff pales in comparison to their dedicated teammates: Phoebe is best used when buffing Zani, Qiuyuan is best to buff Galbrena, and even to buff Phoebe she already has enough DMG Amplification in her own kit which makes a secondary source of damage like Phrolova stronger than Iuno. Nevertheless, Iuno is easily capable of buffing their damage and she brings her own personal damage and sustain to the table if desired.

Iuno's array of Support choices that are all very strong. Mornye has a special synergy with Lynae since Lynae can apply Tune Rupture/Strain for Mornye to respond to them and provide her full array of buffs, making her the best choice generally if Lynae is in use. While Aero Rover only sees use over Shorekeeper in Main DPS Iuno teams for general Aero Buffs, Shorekeeper and Verina are your best generalist bets thanks to their general DMG Amplification Outro, high ATK buffs and even CRIT buffs in the case of Shorekeeper, making for great pairings overall.

example_teams.team_notes: Chisa is only best in slot with yangyang-xuanling - prioritize Shorekeeper with Augusta.

Mornye is only best with Lynae on the team. Only use Aero Rover over Shorekeeper with Ciaccona as your second slot partner. Use Shorekeeper in other scenarios (using Ciaccona in the third slot with Lynae is also amazing).
